name: AI Sales Agent & Shopping Assistant for WooCommerce – WPCreatix
author: WPCreatix

sections.description:
WPCreatix AI Sales Agent is an AI shopping assistant for WooCommerce that does more than answer support questions. Most chatbots reply from a script or a help doc. This one reads your real product catalog and acts on it: it recommends products you actually sell, adds simple and variable products to the cart, applies existing coupon codes, and hands the shopper a ready checkout link. When a conversation helps close a sale, that order is marked in WooCommerce and counted on your Results page.

The plugin is free and there is no license key. You create a WPCreatix account, paste a one-time connection code, and the assistant goes live on your storefront. New accounts start on a free tier, so you can try it on real traffic before you pay for anything.

What the agent does

  • Answers buying questions from your synced catalog. It talks about products you sell, at the prices you charge, and says so when something is out of stock.
  • Recommends products that match what the shopper described, shown as product cards in the chat.
  • Adds simple and variable products to the WooCommerce cart. For a variation it asks which size or color the shopper wants instead of guessing, and stock is checked when the item is added.
  • Applies existing coupon codes, and explains plainly when a code will not work because it expired or the minimum was not met.
  • Builds a checkout link so the shopper lands on checkout with the cart already filled.
  • Answers live shipping and payment questions from your real store settings rather than a guess.
  • Looks up order status for signed-in customers, with ownership checked on our server before anything is shown.

Built for real WooCommerce stores

  • Free plugin, no license key. Connect with a one-time code from your dashboard.
  • Catalog sync runs in the background and keeps itself current when you edit a product, change stock, or trash a listing.
  • AI-assisted orders get a badge on the WooCommerce orders screen and a summary box on the order edit page. HPOS and cart and checkout blocks are supported.
  • Multilingual stores work out of the box with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and GTranslate in subdirectory mode. Shoppers get product links in their own language.
  • The agent replies in the shopper’s language on its own.
  • You control the rest from the dashboard: colors and greeting, what the agent is allowed to do, a daily conversation limit, and an instant off switch for each store.
  • Page-cache safe. No secret is ever written into your page HTML, so full-page caching and a CDN are fine.

How the service works

The plugin is free. Conversations run on a prepaid credit balance in your WPCreatix account, and one credit covers an entire conversation however long it runs, so nothing meters you per message. When the balance reaches zero the widget hides itself until your credits refresh or you top up. Nothing bills in the background and there is no metered overage. Plan details are on the plans page.

Docs

Setup guides, the full settings reference, and troubleshooting are at agent.wpcreatix.com/docs. Good places to start are the quickstart and widget not showing.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  2. Create a free account at agent.wpcreatix.com and generate a connection code on the Sites page.
  3. In wp-admin, open the “AI Sales Agent” menu, paste the code, and click “Connect store”.
  4. The catalog syncs in the background and the chat widget appears on your storefront within a few minutes.

The full walkthrough with screenshots is in the quickstart guide.
sections.faq:
How do I add an AI sales agent to my WooCommerce store?

Install this plugin, create a free account at agent.wpcreatix.com, and paste the one-time connection code into the plugin’s settings page. The AI shopping assistant appears on your storefront on its own. There are no theme edits and no code.

How is this different from a normal chatbot?

A scripted chatbot answers from a fixed list of replies or a help doc. This agent reads your live WooCommerce catalog, so it recommends real products at real prices, adds the right variation to the cart, applies a coupon, and builds a checkout link. It does the things a salesperson would do, not just answer FAQs.

Can the AI add products to the cart?

Yes. It adds simple and variable products to the WooCommerce cart. For a variable product it asks which option the shopper wants, adds the exact variation, and checks stock at that moment. Your mini-cart updates through the standard WooCommerce fragments, so the theme stays in sync.

Can it check order status?

Yes, for a customer who is signed in to your store. The agent looks up the order and confirms the buyer owns it on our server before it shows anything, so one shopper can never read another’s order.

Is there a free version, and do I need a paid plan?

Every new account starts on a free tier with a monthly conversation allowance, and the agent behaves the same there as on any tier. Paid plans are for stores that want more conversations a month, more connected stores, or extra customization. The plans page lists what each tier includes.

Do I need a license key?

No. The plugin is free for everyone. Your store connects to your WPCreatix account with a one-time code instead of a license key.

Does it work with product variations?

Yes. For a variable product the agent asks which option the shopper wants, such as size or color, and adds that exact variation to the cart. It does not guess a variation, and stock is checked when the item is added.

Does it work with WPML or Polylang?

Yes, with no configuration. Translated products sync as one group, so the agent links a shopper to the product page in their own language and adds the matching language version to the cart. TranslatePress, Weglot, and GTranslate in subdirectory mode work too. See multilingual stores.

Is my chat data used to train AI?

No. Conversations run the service for your store, transcripts are anonymized after 90 days, and chat data is not used to train AI models. See privacy and data retention.

Can I turn the agent off?

Yes, instantly. Every store has an off switch in the dashboard, plus a daily conversation limit, page-level hiding, and a mobile toggle. Credits are only spent on conversations that actually happen.

Will it slow down my store or break my theme?

The widget is a small overlay loaded from our servers, and it does not touch your theme templates. After the agent changes the cart, your theme’s mini-cart refreshes through the standard WooCommerce fragments mechanism. HPOS and cart and checkout blocks are supported.

The chat widget is not showing. What do I check?

Most often the store is disconnected, out of credits, or the agent is switched off for that store. The step-by-step checklist is at widget not showing.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • AI sales agent for WooCommerce: catalog-grounded answers, product recommendations with product cards, add to cart including variations, coupon codes, checkout links, live shipping and payment answers, and order status for signed-in customers.
  • Background catalog sync that keeps product, price, and stock data current, with WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, Weglot, and GTranslate support.
  • AI-assisted orders badged on the orders screen with a summary on the order edit page. HPOS and cart and checkout blocks supported.
  • Dashboard controls for appearance, agent capabilities, daily conversation limits, and a per-store off switch.
